component-o.description-s: 6-A, 12-V Input Non-Isolated Wide-Output Adjust Power Module

cfgpins-ao.4c: Inhibit left open: internal pull-up, the module runs when input power is applied (datasheet pin note); pull low with a low-leakage open-drain to inhibit

cfgpins-ao.5c: Adjust left open: VO defaults to the 1.2 V the row records (RSET open circuit, datasheet); an RSET to GND sets a higher VO

load_transient-ao.table-s: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS (PTH12050W): Transient response, 1 A/us load step, 50 to 100 % IOmax, C3 = 100 uF: VO over/undershoot 100 mV typ, recovery 70 us (TA 25 C, VI 12 V, VO 3.3 V, IOmax 6 A)
load_transient-ao.derived-s: 50 to 100 % of IOmax 6 A = 3 A to 6 A, a 3 A step

load_regulation_source-o.table-s: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS (PTH12050W): Load regulation over IO range +/-5 mV typ (VI 12 V, VO 3.3 V, IO 0 to 6 A)
load_regulation_source-o.derived-s: +/-5 mV band = 10 mV over 0 to 6 A = 1.67 mV/A (typical; no max stated)

cout_source-o.table-s: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS: external output capacitance C3, nonceramic 0 min / 100 typ / 3300 max uF, ceramic 0 min / 300 max uF; note 5: an external output capacitor is not required for basic operation; Output Capacitors (Optional) p10: 100 uF defines the transient spec. C2 10 uF ceramic is an input capacitor (Standard Application p1)

specs-o.params_gate_note-s: cout_min_nf is 0 as stated (output capacitor optional, SLTS214H p3 note 5 and p10); the gate counts only a positive cout_min_nf, so this row fails on a stated value, not a missing one
